purpose: Primary structural carbohydrate and protein source in baking and dough formation
concerns: Contains gluten, not suitable for individuals with Coeliac disease or wheat allergy.

purpose: Provides sweetness, body, moisture retention, and browning (caramelization / Maillard reaction)
dietary: Vegetarian, Vegan (may involve bone char filtration in some traditional refining processes)
concerns: High consumption of free sugars is associated with dental caries, metabolic syndrome, and obesity.

purpose: Provides solid fat structure, oxidative stability, smooth mouthfeel, and frying stability
concerns: Rich in palmitic acid (saturated fat); moderate consumption recommended in cardiovascular dietary guidelines.

purpose: Imparts dairy flavour, tenderness, browning, and contributes milk protein and calcium
concerns: Contains dairy proteins (casein, whey) and lactose; triggers milk allergy and lactose intolerance.

purpose: Blends hydrophobic and hydrophilic ingredients, improves dough flow, and maintains emulsion stability
concerns: Individuals with acute IgE-mediated soy allergy should note the botanical source.

purpose: Flavour enhancement, gluten matrix strengthening in dough, microbial preservation
concerns: High sodium intake is linked with elevated blood pressure and cardiovascular risk.

purpose: Retains moisture, prevents crystallization of sugars, and enhances softness in baked goods
Releases carbon dioxide gas when exposed to heat or acid, leavening the dough
Rapid leavening agent for low-moisture baked goods (cookies and crackers)
concerns: Dissipates during baking; safe when used as directed.

purpose: Antimicrobial agent that inhibits growth of yeasts, moulds, and bacteria in acidic foods
concerns: Subject to strict regulatory limits; interaction with ascorbic acid (vitamin C) can generate trace benzene.

purpose: Controls pH, enhances tart flavor profile, and acts as a synergistic antioxidant
concerns: Generally safe; acid erosion on tooth enamel if consumed frequently in concentrated acidic beverages.

purpose: Provides chocolate flavor, dark color, and polyphenolic flavonoids
concerns: Natural source of theobromine and caffeine.
